description: Defines exceptions related to barrier job allocation failures in Apache Spark, including specific error messages and classes for unsupported RDD patterns, dynamic allocation issues, and slot number checks.

classes.name: BarrierJobAllocationFailed
classes.description: Base exception class for barrier job allocation failures in Spark.

classes.name: BarrierJobUnsupportedRDDChainException
classes.description: Exception for unsupported RDD chain patterns in barrier jobs.

classes.name: BarrierJobRunWithDynamicAllocationException
classes.description: Exception for attempting to run barrier jobs with dynamic resource allocation enabled.

classes.name: BarrierJobSlotsNumberCheckFailed
classes.description: Exception when the required slots exceed the current total slots.

methods.description: Constructor for the base barrier job allocation failure exception.
